A tidy-up release: nothing changes in how the program works.

### What's changed
- Notes inside the program's code were reworded. Your cards, photos, backups and settings work exactly as in 3.0.17.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients, people and settings.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.18 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.18.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
